column1: # Per-sample path-aware EDP -- hybrid testbenches (A=Monte Carlo random every step,
# B=full sweep in either natural +1 order or Gray-code order), RCA/CLA/SD, 2/4/8-bit.
# Each combination run as 1000 independent trials (distinct seeds 1-1000, 2^N steps
# per trial). For each trial: per-sample switches_i*delay_i computed and averaged WITHIN
# that trial (same per-sample methodology as the exhaustive/Monte Carlo pathEDP work),
# then that per-trial average is itself averaged across all 1000 trials. AvgEDP_Naive =
# mean(switches across trials) * mean(delay across trials), shown for comparison.
# SD/TC-PM and SD/TC-PPM: "A"=SD (Monte Carlo random every step), "B"=TC (swept),
# both using the same canonical 2^N x 2^N encoding (SD_a = value's own bits, SD_b = 0
# always) as their exhaustive-natural-order and Gray-exhaustive tables.
